interpretation.performance: Single-machine observations, no controlled before/after LCP benchmark or field p75 claim. Home internal cache naturally moved HIT -> STALE (10 ms) -> HIT (8 ms); CDN returned UPDATING promptly; repeat SW navigation made zero network requests for 56 cached immutable assets.
interpretation.noJs: Chrome reports csp request failures when JavaScript is explicitly disabled. These 33 script requests were separated from real failures; enabled-JS contexts had no unexpected failures.
interpretation.detail: Rendered existing README, code and exact slug install command checked visually. The sample has no precomputed recommendations and returned an empty recommendation list; absence is not claimed as successful recommendation population.
interpretation.logError: 31 error-level events were 404s on unrelated unsupported routes such as /xmlrpc.php and WordPress/resource probes. These were not test traffic; no uncaught exceptions, failed execution outcomes or tested-route error logs were observed.
interpretation.credentials: Cloudflare OAuth expired during metrics inspection; a standard Wrangler read refreshed it and metrics then succeeded. No credentials were saved to this evidence.

safety.analyticsAndMutationRequests: Blocked in isolated anonymous verification browsers
safety.readOnlyPreflight: Fresh existing home snapshot and eligible IDs; existing highlighted README; absent precomputed recommendations; complete predefined category aggregates; Recent/Top cache object conditions checked before requests

limitations: Authenticated pages and login/logout were not exercised. The connected user browser could not provide the required request-interception command; its static-resource-only tab was closed without entering user data pages.

Production write flows (publish, upload, bookmark mutation, permissions, organizations, tokens and notifications) were not executed. Local tests cover relevant contracts; no production fixtures were created.
Classification had no natural event during the bounded window. Security cron success does not demonstrate Jev/OpenRouter inference, retry or persistence; no test tasks or paid calls were injected.

Classification and security main queues were empty at inspection; their DLQs held 3 and 6 messages. These were neither read nor replayed; no before-deploy DLQ count was collected, so this release is not attributed as their cause.
True missing-R2 Markdown highlighting and recommendation refresh writes were tested in isolation, not forced on production.
Cross-deployment SW cache retention was verified locally; production verified current artifact and repeat cached loads only.
